name: kv_store
spec: Create a distributed key-value store running on a single machine using multiple processes in Python with only the standard library. The system consists of a router process that distributes keys across multiple storage node processes using consistent hashing. Clients connect to the router via TCP sockets. The store supports basic CRUD operations, TTL-based expiration, and node failure detection.
features: A router process starts and listens for client connections on a configurable TCP port
Multiple storage node processes start and register themselves with the router
Keys are distributed across nodes using consistent hashing so each node owns a range of keys
A client can SET a key-value pair which gets routed to the correct node
A client can GET a value by key which gets routed to the correct node and returns the value
A client can DELETE a key which removes it from the correct node
SET supports an optional TTL in seconds after which the key automatically expires
A client can LIST all keys optionally filtered by a prefix pattern
The router detects when a storage node becomes unresponsive via periodic health checks
When a node fails, the router redistributes its key range to remaining nodes
A simple CLI client is included for interacting with the store
All communication uses a simple text-based protocol over TCP sockets
The router logs all operations and node status changes
Multiple clients can connect and operate concurrently without data corruption
A startup script launches the router and a configurable number of nodes
